claim: Apple reports $85.8B revenue for fiscal Q3 2024
summary: Apple reported fiscal Q3 2024 (June quarter) revenue of $85.777B on Aug 1, 2024, consistently rounded and reported as $85.8B, so the claim is supported.

sub_claims.text: Apple reported results for fiscal Q3 2024
sub_claims.stated_text: Apple reports $85.8B revenue for fiscal Q3 2024
sub_claims.note: Apple's FY ends in September, so fiscal Q3 2024 is the June quarter reported on August 1, 2024.

sub_claims.text: Revenue for that quarter was $85.8 billion
sub_claims.note: Actual reported revenue was $85.777 billion, which rounds to $85.8B as stated.
